subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own known forum topic-name to topic_id resolution for routing: an observed topic catalog/list action, a direct resolver, or session context injection?
rationale: Current code has a persisted id-to-name cache, but reversing it for routing changes agent/tool contracts and needs maintainer intent for ambiguity, freshness, permissions, and safe failure behavior.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Resolver-Only Helper
options.body: Add a direct name-to-id resolver that returns structured ambiguity or stale-cache errors instead of silently routing.

options.title: Keep Numeric IDs For Now
options.body: Leave numeric topic ids as the only supported routing contract and document the manual-map workaround until a stronger surface is chosen.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent topic-cache persistence and Telegram action-normalization history is closest to the likely resolver/list implementation boundary.
